name: Seam-ripper
description: Ghan's blade that parts the Weft to open passages between lamellae.

timeline.summary: Ghan weftwalks into the abandoned Cail Station and feels the wrongness within.
timeline.quote: The moment Ghan's seam-ripper parted space, cutting a radiant blue line from the void into the station's dark, debris-strewn arcade, he felt the change.

timeline.summary: Ghan chases Kesori through the city by microstepping through the Weft.
timeline.quote: A split second later, he dropped out of a shining slit in the air, a scant few meters in front of Kesori.

timeline.summary: Ghan cuts the artifact in half with his seam-ripper, destroying it.
timeline.quote: Half of the artifact dropped to the floor with a clatter of finality.

pages_say.description: Drix magnifying anchors that amplify and direct weftwalking while anchoring the Drix to their home lamella.
